## Troubleshooting

### Session creation fails with "Sandbox executor URL not configured"

The web app can't find the sandbox server URL. Either:
- Set `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` in `apps/web/.env.local`
- Or set `executorConfig.url` on the agent in the database

### Disk quota exceeded (HTTP 413)

A session has used more than 100 MB. The agent needs to clean up files or start a new conversation. Adjust `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` if needed.

### Tool execution timeout

Default timeout is 30 seconds for `shellExec`. For long operations like `git clone` of large repos, the agent should pass `"timeout": 60000` or higher (max 300000).

### "Maximum concurrent sessions reached"

The server is at capacity. Sessions expire after 1 hour by default. Either:
- Wait for sessions to expire
- Increase `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS`
- Destroy idle sessions manually

### Module import failures

The sandbox server imports npm packages from `esm.sh`. If a package fails to load:
- Check the package is published to npm
- Check `esm.sh` status
- Try specifying `importUrl` to use a different CDN

### Git clone fails for private repos

Ensure `GITHUB_TOKEN` is set as an environment variable on the sandbox server (not just in the web app). The credential helper reads it from the server's environment.

### Files disappear between tool calls

Check that the same `sessionId` is being used. The conversation route generates `{agentId}:{conversationId}` — if the conversation ID changes, it's a new session.

### "Path escapes sandbox workspace"

A tool tried to read/write outside the workspace (e.g. `../../etc/passwd`). This is a security violation and is blocked. All paths must be relative to the workspace root.

    92→| **Conversation Route** | `apps/web/src/app/api/[username]/agents/[agentSlug]/conversation/[conversationId]/route.ts` | SSE streaming endpoint, creates sessions, persists messages |

    96→
    97→## How It Works
    98→
    99→### End-to-End Flow
   100→
   101→1. **User sends a message** to an agent configured with `executorType: 'sandbox'`
   102→2. **Conversation route** creates (or resumes) a sandbox session: `POST /sessions` with ID `{agentId}:{conversationId}`
   103→3. **AI model** decides to call a tool (e.g. `shellExec` with `git clone ...`)
   104→4. **Tool builder** wraps the tool in an executor-aware definition that routes the call to the sandbox server
   105→5. **Executor layer** sends `POST /execute-tool` to the sandbox with the `sessionId`
   106→6. **Sandbox server** resolves the session's `workDir`, injects `_sandboxWorkDir` into tool params, and executes
   107→7. **Tool runs** in the session workspace — files persist on disk
   108→8. **Result flows back** through the AI SDK to the model, which may call more tools or respond with text
   109→9. **Messages are persisted** to PostgreSQL (USER, ASSISTANT with toolCalls, TOOL with toolResult)
   110→10. **On conversation delete**, the session is destroyed (fire-and-forget)
   111→
   112→### Statefulness
   113→
   114→The key difference from the default executor is **persistence**. Within a sandbox session:
   115→
   116→- Files created by `writeFile` or `shellExec` persist across tool calls
   117→- Git repositories cloned in one turn are available in the next
   118→- The working directory is the same for every tool call in the session
   119→- Environment variables are injected per-call (not persistent across calls)
   120→
   121→### Module Loading
   122→
   123→The sandbox server dynamically imports npm packages from `esm.sh`:
   124→
   125→```
   126→https://esm.sh/@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell@0.1.0
   127→```
   128→
   129→Modules are cached in memory for 2 minutes (up to 200 entries). The server supports:
   130→- Direct tool exports (`export const toolName = tool({...})`)
   131→- Factory functions (`export function toolName(config) { return tool({...}) }`)
   132→- Zod schemas (converted via `zod-to-json-schema`)
   133→

   135→
   136→## Session Lifecycle
   137→
   138→```
   139→ POST /sessions ─────────────────────► Session Created
   140→   { sessionId }                       workDir: /tmp/.../workspace
   141→                                       TTL: 1 hour
   142→                                       │
   143→                                       │ Each tool call:
   144→                                       │  - Extends TTL
   145→                                       │  - Increments toolCallCount
   146→                                       │  - Checks disk quota
   147→                                       │
   148→                                       ▼
   149→ POST /execute-tool ─────────────────► Tool Executes in workDir
   150→   { sessionId, packageName,           _sandboxWorkDir injected
   151→     name, params }                    │
   152→                                       │
   153→                 ┌─────────────────────┤
   154→                 │                     │
   155→                 ▼                     ▼
   156→         TTL Expires              DELETE /sessions/{id}
   157→         (cleanup timer)          (explicit destroy)
   158→                 │                     │
   159→                 ▼                     ▼
   160→         Session Destroyed ◄───────── workDir removed
   161→         (every 60s sweep)
   162→```
   163→
   164→### Session Properties
   165→
   166→| Property | Description |
   167→|----------|-------------|
   168→| `sessionId` | Unique ID, typically `{agentId}:{conversationId}` |
   169→| `workDir` | Filesystem path: `/tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions/{safe-id}/workspace` |
   170→| `createdAt` | When the session was first created |
   171→| `expiresAt` | TTL deadline, extended on every tool call |
   172→| `toolCallCount` | Number of tool calls executed in this session |
   173→
   174→### Idempotent Creation
   175→
   176→Calling `POST /sessions` with an existing `sessionId` doesn't create a new session — it extends the TTL and returns the existing one with `resumed: true`. This makes it safe to call at the start of every conversation turn.
   177→
   178→### Cleanup
   179→
   180→- **TTL expiration**: A sweep runs every 60 seconds, destroying sessions past their `expiresAt`
   181→- **Explicit deletion**: `DELETE /sessions/{id}` immediately destroys the session and removes files
   182→- **Orphan cleanup**: On server startup, any leftover session directories from a previous run are removed
   183→- **Graceful shutdown**: `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` destroy all active sessions before exit

   187→## Shell Tools
   188→
   189→The `@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell` package provides 4 tools that run inside the sandbox workspace.
   190→
   191→### `shellExec`
   192→
   193→Execute any shell command in the workspace.
   194→
   195→```json
   196→{
   197→  "command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1",
   198→  "timeout": 60000
   199→}
   200→```
   201→
   202→**Returns:**
   203→```json
   204→{
   205→  "stdout": "Cloning into 'repo'...\n",
   206→  "stderr": "",
   207→  "exitCode": 0,
   208→  "durationMs": 2341,
   209→  "truncated": false
   210→}
   211→```
   212→
   213→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   214→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   215→| `command` | string | *required* | Shell command (passed to `sh -c`) |
   216→| `timeout` | number | 30000 | Timeout in ms (min: 1000, max: 300000) |
   217→
   218→**Behavior:**
   219→- Runs via `Deno.Command('sh', { args: ['-c', command], cwd: workDir })`
   220→- On timeout: sends `SIGTERM`, waits 2s, then `SIGKILL`
   221→- stdout/stderr truncated at 100 KB each
   222→- Exit code 137 indicates timeout kill
   223→
   224→### `readFile`
   225→
   226→Read a file from the workspace.
   227→
   228→```json
   229→{
   230→  "path": "repo/src/index.ts"
   231→}
   232→```
   233→
   234→**Returns:**
   235→```json
   236→{
   237→  "content": "console.log('hello');\n",
   238→  "path": "repo/src/index.ts",
   239→  "size": 22,
   240→  "truncated": false
   241→}
   242→```
   243→
   244→| Parameter | Type | Description |
   245→|-----------|------|-------------|
   246→| `path` | string | File path relative to workspace root |
   247→
   248→**Behavior:**
   249→- Content truncated at 500 KB
   250→- Symlink escape detection via `Deno.realPath()`
   251→- Path traversal (`../`) blocked
   252→
   253→### `writeFile`
   254→
   255→Create or overwrite a file.
   256→
   257→```json
   258→{
   259→  "path": "src/main.py",
   260→  "content": "print('hello')\n",
   261→  "createDirs": true
   262→}
   263→```
   264→
   265→**Returns:**
   266→```json
   267→{
   268→  "success": true,
   269→  "path": "src/main.py",
   270→  "bytesWritten": 16
   271→}
   272→```
   273→
   274→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   275→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   276→| `path` | string | *required* | File path relative to workspace root |
   277→| `content` | string | *required* | Content to write |
   278→| `createDirs` | boolean | true | Create parent directories if needed |
   279→
   280→### `listFiles`
   281→
   282→List files and directories.
   283→
   284→```json
   285→{
   286→  "path": "repo",
   287→  "recursive": true,
   288→  "maxDepth": 2
   289→}
   290→```
   291→
   292→**Returns:**
   293→```json
   294→{
   295→  "path": "repo",
   296→  "entries": [
   297→    { "name": "README.md", "type": "file", "size": 1024 },
   298→    { "name": "src", "type": "directory", "size": null },
   299→    { "name": "src/index.ts", "type": "file", "size": 256 }
   300→  ],
   301→  "truncated": false
   302→}
   303→```
   304→
   305→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   306→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   307→| `path` | string | `.` | Directory path relative to workspace root |
   308→| `recursive` | boolean | false | List recursively |
   309→| `maxDepth` | number | 3 | Max depth for recursive listing |
   310→
   311→**Behavior:**
   312→- Capped at 1000 entries (sets `truncated: true` beyond that)
   313→- Symlinks pointing outside workspace are silently skipped
   314→- Broken symlinks are skipped
   315→
   316→### `_sandboxWorkDir` Injection
   317→
   318→All tools accept a `_sandboxWorkDir` parameter, but agents never set it directly. The sandbox server injects it automatically:
   319→
   320→```typescript
   321→// server.ts line 420
   322→const executeParams = cwd ? { ...params, _sandboxWorkDir: cwd } : params;
   323→```
   324→
   325→If `_sandboxWorkDir` is missing (tool called outside a sandbox), all tools throw a clear error.

   328→
   329→## Executor Configuration
   330→
   331→### Cascade Resolution
   332→
   333→Tool execution is routed through a 3-level cascade:
   334→
   335→```
   336→Agent.executorType / Agent.executorConfig     (highest priority)
   337→  └── Collection.executorType / Collection.executorConfig
   338→        └── System default                    (lowest priority)
   339→```
   340→
   341→This means:
   342→- An agent-level executor config applies to **all** tools in the agent
   343→- A collection-level executor config applies only to tools from that collection
   344→- The system default (`package-executor`) is used when nothing else is configured
   345→
   346→### Executor Types
   347→
   348→| Type | Description | Config Fields |
   349→|------|-------------|---------------|
   350→| `default` | TPMJS default stateless executor | None |
   351→| `custom_url` | Your own HTTP executor endpoint | `url`, `apiKey` |
   352→| `sandbox` | Agent Sandbox with persistent sessions | `url` (optional), `apiKey` (optional) |
   353→
   354→### Database Schema
   355→
   356→```prisma
   357→model Agent {
   358→  executorType    String?   // 'default', 'custom_url', 'sandbox'
   359→  executorConfig  Json?     // { type, url?, apiKey? }
   360→  envVars         Json?     // { KEY: "value", ... }
   361→}
   362→
   363→model Collection {
   364→  executorType    String?
   365→  executorConfig  Json?
   366→  envVars         Json?
   367→}
   368→```
   369→
   370→### Environment Variable Merging
   371→
   372→Environment variables are merged with agent-level overriding collection-level:
   373→
   374→```
   375→Collection envVars:  { API_KEY: "coll-key", REGION: "us-east-1" }
   376→Agent envVars:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", DEBUG: "true" }
   377→                          ↓
   378→Merged result:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", REGION: "us-east-1", DEBUG: "true" }
   379→```
   380→
   381→Env vars are passed to the sandbox server per tool call and cleaned up after execution.
   382→

   598→## Security Model
   599→
   600→### Authentication
   601→
   602→All endpoints except `/health` and `/metrics` require a Bearer token when `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` is set. If unset, auth is disabled (development mode only).
   603→
   604→### Path Sandboxing
   605→
   606→All file tools enforce workspace boundaries:
   607→
   608→1. **Path normalization**: `../` segments are resolved and checked
   609→2. **Boundary check**: Resolved path must start with `workDir`
   610→3. **Symlink detection**: `Deno.realPath()` verifies the canonical path stays in workspace
   611→4. **Escape rejection**: Throws `"Path escapes sandbox workspace"` on violation
   612→
   613→```typescript
   614→function resolveSandboxPath(workDir: string, relativePath: string): string {
   615→  // Normalize, resolve .., validate prefix
   616→  if (!final.startsWith(normalizedWorkDir)) {
   617→    throw new Error(`Path escapes sandbox workspace: ${relativePath}`);
   618→  }
   619→  return final;
   620→}
   621→```
   622→
   623→### Disk Quotas
   624→
   625→Before every tool execution, the server checks workspace size:
   626→
   627→```
   628→if (usageKB > SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB * 1024) → HTTP 413
   629→```
   630→
   631→Default: 100 MB per session.
   632→
   633→### Process Isolation
   634→
   635→- The Deno server runs as the `deno` user (non-root)
   636→- Write access is restricted to `/tmp` (`--allow-write=/tmp`)
   637→- Each session has its own workspace directory
   638→- Environment variables are cleaned up after each tool call
   639→
   640→### Timeout Protection
   641→
   642→- `shellExec`: Configurable per-call (default 30s, max 5min)
   643→- `SIGTERM` → 2s grace → `SIGKILL`
   644→- HTTP-level timeout on executor calls: 5 minutes
   645→- Session creation timeout: 15 seconds
   646→
   647→### Output Truncation
   648→
   649→| Resource | Limit |
   650→|----------|-------|
   651→| stdout/stderr | 100 KB each |
   652→| File reads | 500 KB |
   653→| Directory listings | 1000 entries |
   654→
   655→### Git Credential Helper
   656→

   707→

   808→# Against local instance (no auth)

   830→
   831→1. Creates a test agent with sandbox executor
   832→2. Multi-turn conversation: clone repo, create files, git commit
   833→3. Verifies stateful persistence across turns

   836→```bash
   837→INTEGRATION_TESTS=true AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=http://localhost:3002 pnpm test

   844→```bash
   845→cd packages/tools/official
   846→blocks run sandbox.shellExec
   847→blocks run sandbox.readFile
   848→blocks run sandbox.writeFile

   857→```

   860→
   861→## Troubleshooting
   862→
   863→### Session creation fails with "Sandbox executor URL not configured"
   864→
   865→The web app can't find the sandbox server URL. Either:
   866→- Set `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` in `apps/web/.env.local`
   867→- Or set `executorConfig.url` on the agent in the database
   868→
   869→### Disk quota exceeded (HTTP 413)
   870→
   871→A session has used more than 100 MB. The agent needs to clean up files or start a new conversation. Adjust `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` if needed.
   872→
   873→### Tool execution timeout
   874→
   875→Default timeout is 30 seconds for `shellExec`. For long operations like `git clone` of large repos, the agent should pass `"timeout": 60000` or higher (max 300000).
   876→
   877→### "Maximum concurrent sessions reached"
   878→
   879→The server is at capacity. Sessions expire after 1 hour by default. Either:
   880→- Wait for sessions to expire
   881→- Increase `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS`
   882→- Destroy idle sessions manually
   883→
   884→### Module import failures
   885→
   886→The sandbox server imports npm packages from `esm.sh`. If a package fails to load:
   887→- Check the package is published to npm
   888→- Check `esm.sh` status
   889→- Try specifying `importUrl` to use a different CDN
   890→
   891→### Git clone fails for private repos
   892→
   893→Ensure `GITHUB_TOKEN` is set as an environment variable on the sandbox server (not just in the web app). The credential helper reads it from the server's environment.
   894→
   895→### Files disappear between tool calls
   896→
   897→Check that the same `sessionId` is being used. The conversation route generates `{agentId}:{conversationId}` — if the conversation ID changes, it's a new session.
   898→
   899→### "Path escapes sandbox workspace"
   900→
   901→A tool tried to read/write outside the workspace (e.g. `../../etc/passwd`). This is a security violation and is blocked. All paths must be relative to the workspace root.
   902→

# TPMJS Agent Sandbox

Stateful execution server for TPMJS agents. Provides persistent filesystem sessions so files created by one tool call survive across subsequent calls within the same conversation. Built on Deno, deployed to Railway (or any Docker host).

## Table of Contents

- [Architecture Overview](#architecture-overview)
- [How It Works](#how-it-works)
- [Session Lifecycle](#session-lifecycle)
- [Shell Tools](#shell-tools)
- [Executor Configuration](#executor-configuration)
- [Environment Variables](#environment-variables)
- [API Reference](#api-reference)
- [Security Model](#security-model)
- [Deployment](#deployment)
- [Local Development](#local-development)
- [Testing](#testing)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

---

## Architecture Overview

```
 User Message
      |
      v
 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │  Next.js API Route (conversation/[id]/route.ts)  │
 │                                                   │
 │  1. Authenticate user                             │
 │  2. Create/resume sandbox session                 │
 │  3. Build tools from agent config                 │
 │  4. Stream AI response via SSE                    │
 │  5. Persist messages + tool results to DB         │
 └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
                         │
           Tool call with sessionId
                         │
                         v
 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │          Executor Layer (lib/executors)           │
 │                                                   │
 │  Resolves config cascade:                         │
 │    Agent Config → Collection Config → Default     │
 │                                                   │
 │  Routes to correct executor:                      │
 │    'default'    → package-executor (stateless)    │
 │    'custom_url' → custom HTTP endpoint            │
 │    'sandbox'    → Agent Sandbox Server ←──────    │
 └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
                         │
               POST /execute-tool
               { sessionId, params }
                         │
                         v
 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │       Agent Sandbox Server (Deno, server.ts)     │
 │                                                   │
 │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
 │  │ Session: agent123:conv456                    │ │
 │  │ workDir: /tmp/.../workspace                  │ │
 │  │ TTL: 1 hour (extends on each tool call)      │ │
 │  │ Disk quota: 100 MB                           │ │
 │  │                                              │ │
 │  │  /workspace/                                 │ │
 │  │  ├── cloned-repo/                            │ │
 │  │  │   ├── .git/                               │ │
 │  │  │   ├── src/                                │ │
 │  │  │   └── README.md                           │ │
 │  │  ├── output.txt                              │ │
 │  │  └── notes.md                                │ │
 │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
 │                                                   │
 │  Tool execution:                                  │
 │  1. Load npm package from esm.sh                  │
 │  2. Inject _sandboxWorkDir into params            │
 │  3. Enforce disk quota                            │
 │  4. Execute tool.execute(params)                  │
 │  5. Return result                                 │
 └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Components

| Component | Location | Purpose |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| **Sandbox Server** | `templates/agent-sandbox/server.ts` | Deno HTTP server with session management, tool execution, module caching |
| **Shell Tools** | `packages/tools/official/sandbox-shell/` | 4 tools: `shellExec`, `readFile`, `writeFile`, `listFiles` |
| **Executor Layer** | `apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts` | Routes tool calls to sandbox with retry logic, session creation/destruction |
| **Tool Builder** | `apps/web/src/lib/agents/build-tools.ts` | Builds AI SDK tool definitions with executor config cascade |
| **Conversation Route** | `apps/web/src/app/api/[username]/agents/[agentSlug]/conversation/[conversationId]/route.ts` | SSE streaming endpoint, creates sessions, persists messages |
| **Dockerfile** | `templates/agent-sandbox/Dockerfile` | Container with Deno, git, openssh-client, credential helper |

---

## How It Works

### End-to-End Flow

1. **User sends a message** to an agent configured with `executorType: 'sandbox'`
2. **Conversation route** creates (or resumes) a sandbox session: `POST /sessions` with ID `{agentId}:{conversationId}`
3. **AI model** decides to call a tool (e.g. `shellExec` with `git clone ...`)
4. **Tool builder** wraps the tool in an executor-aware definition that routes the call to the sandbox server
5. **Executor layer** sends `POST /execute-tool` to the sandbox with the `sessionId`
6. **Sandbox server** resolves the session's `workDir`, injects `_sandboxWorkDir` into tool params, and executes
7. **Tool runs** in the session workspace — files persist on disk
8. **Result flows back** through the AI SDK to the model, which may call more tools or respond with text
9. **Messages are persisted** to PostgreSQL (USER, ASSISTANT with toolCalls, TOOL with toolResult)
10. **On conversation delete**, the session is destroyed (fire-and-forget)

### Statefulness

The key difference from the default executor is **persistence**. Within a sandbox session:

- Files created by `writeFile` or `shellExec` persist across tool calls
- Git repositories cloned in one turn are available in the next
- The working directory is the same for every tool call in the session
- Environment variables are injected per-call (not persistent across calls)

### Module Loading

The sandbox server dynamically imports npm packages from `esm.sh`:

```
https://esm.sh/@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell@0.1.0
```

Modules are cached in memory for 2 minutes (up to 200 entries). The server supports:
- Direct tool exports (`export const toolName = tool({...})`)
- Factory functions (`export function toolName(config) { return tool({...}) }`)
- Zod schemas (converted via `zod-to-json-schema`)

---

## Session Lifecycle

```
 POST /sessions ─────────────────────► Session Created
   { sessionId }                       workDir: /tmp/.../workspace
                                       TTL: 1 hour
                                       │
                                       │ Each tool call:
                                       │  - Extends TTL
                                       │  - Increments toolCallCount
                                       │  - Checks disk quota
                                       │
                                       ▼
 POST /execute-tool ─────────────────► Tool Executes in workDir
   { sessionId, packageName,           _sandboxWorkDir injected
     name, params }                    │
                                       │
                 ┌─────────────────────┤
                 │                     │
                 ▼                     ▼
         TTL Expires              DELETE /sessions/{id}
         (cleanup timer)          (explicit destroy)
                 │                     │
                 ▼                     ▼
         Session Destroyed ◄───────── workDir removed
         (every 60s sweep)
```

### Session Properties

| Property | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `sessionId` | Unique ID, typically `{agentId}:{conversationId}` |
| `workDir` | Filesystem path: `/tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions/{safe-id}/workspace` |
| `createdAt` | When the session was first created |
| `expiresAt` | TTL deadline, extended on every tool call |
| `toolCallCount` | Number of tool calls executed in this session |

### Idempotent Creation

Calling `POST /sessions` with an existing `sessionId` doesn't create a new session — it extends the TTL and returns the existing one with `resumed: true`. This makes it safe to call at the start of every conversation turn.

### Cleanup

- **TTL expiration**: A sweep runs every 60 seconds, destroying sessions past their `expiresAt`
- **Explicit deletion**: `DELETE /sessions/{id}` immediately destroys the session and removes files
- **Orphan cleanup**: On server startup, any leftover session directories from a previous run are removed
- **Graceful shutdown**: `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` destroy all active sessions before exit

---

## Shell Tools

The `@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell` package provides 4 tools that run inside the sandbox workspace.

### `shellExec`

Execute any shell command in the workspace.

```json
{
  "command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1",
  "timeout": 60000
}
```

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "stdout": "Cloning into 'repo'...\n",
  "stderr": "",
  "exitCode": 0,
  "durationMs": 2341,
  "truncated": false
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `command` | string | *required* | Shell command (passed to `sh -c`) |
| `timeout` | number | 30000 | Timeout in ms (min: 1000, max: 300000) |

**Behavior:**
- Runs via `Deno.Command('sh', { args: ['-c', command], cwd: workDir })`
- On timeout: sends `SIGTERM`, waits 2s, then `SIGKILL`
- stdout/stderr truncated at 100 KB each
- Exit code 137 indicates timeout kill

### `readFile`

Read a file from the workspace.

```json
{
  "path": "repo/src/index.ts"
}
```

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "content": "console.log('hello');\n",
  "path": "repo/src/index.ts",
  "size": 22,
  "truncated": false
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `path` | string | File path relative to workspace root |

**Behavior:**
- Content truncated at 500 KB
- Symlink escape detection via `Deno.realPath()`
- Path traversal (`../`) blocked

### `writeFile`

Create or overwrite a file.

```json
{
  "path": "src/main.py",
  "content": "print('hello')\n",
  "createDirs": true
}
```

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "path": "src/main.py",
  "bytesWritten": 16
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | string | *required* | File path relative to workspace root |
| `content` | string | *required* | Content to write |
| `createDirs` | boolean | true | Create parent directories if needed |

### `listFiles`

List files and directories.

```json
{
  "path": "repo",
  "recursive": true,
  "maxDepth": 2
}
```

**Returns:**
```json
{
  "path": "repo",
  "entries": [
    { "name": "README.md", "type": "file", "size": 1024 },
    { "name": "src", "type": "directory", "size": null },
    { "name": "src/index.ts", "type": "file", "size": 256 }
  ],
  "truncated": false
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | string | `.` | Directory path relative to workspace root |
| `recursive` | boolean | false | List recursively |
| `maxDepth` | number | 3 | Max depth for recursive listing |

**Behavior:**
- Capped at 1000 entries (sets `truncated: true` beyond that)
- Symlinks pointing outside workspace are silently skipped
- Broken symlinks are skipped

### `_sandboxWorkDir` Injection

All tools accept a `_sandboxWorkDir` parameter, but agents never set it directly. The sandbox server injects it automatically:

```typescript
// server.ts line 420
const executeParams = cwd ? { ...params, _sandboxWorkDir: cwd } : params;
```

If `_sandboxWorkDir` is missing (tool called outside a sandbox), all tools throw a clear error.

---

## Executor Configuration

### Cascade Resolution

Tool execution is routed through a 3-level cascade:

```
Agent.executorType / Agent.executorConfig     (highest priority)
  └── Collection.executorType / Collection.executorConfig
        └── System default                    (lowest priority)
```

This means:
- An agent-level executor config applies to **all** tools in the agent
- A collection-level executor config applies only to tools from that collection
- The system default (`package-executor`) is used when nothing else is configured

### Executor Types

| Type | Description | Config Fields |
|------|-------------|---------------|
| `default` | TPMJS default stateless executor | None |
| `custom_url` | Your own HTTP executor endpoint | `url`, `apiKey` |
| `sandbox` | Agent Sandbox with persistent sessions | `url` (optional), `apiKey` (optional) |

### Database Schema

```prisma
model Agent {
  executorType    String?   // 'default', 'custom_url', 'sandbox'
  executorConfig  Json?     // { type, url?, apiKey? }
  envVars         Json?     // { KEY: "value", ... }
}

model Collection {
  executorType    String?
  executorConfig  Json?
  envVars         Json?
}
```

### Environment Variable Merging

Environment variables are merged with agent-level overriding collection-level:

```
Collection envVars:  { API_KEY: "coll-key", REGION: "us-east-1" }
Agent envVars:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", DEBUG: "true" }
                          ↓
Merged result:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", REGION: "us-east-1", DEBUG: "true" }
```

Env vars are passed to the sandbox server per tool call and cleaned up after execution.

---

## Environment Variables

### Sandbox Server

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `PORT` | No | `3002` | Server port |
| `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` | No | — | Bearer token for authentication. If unset, auth is disabled. |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS` | No | `50` | Maximum concurrent sessions |
| `DEFAULT_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS` | No | `3600` | Session timeout (1 hour) |
| `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` | No | `100` | Per-session disk quota |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | No | — | GitHub PAT for cloning private repos via credential helper |

### Web App

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` | Yes (for sandbox agents) | URL of the sandbox server (e.g. `https://sandbox.example.com`) |

The URL can also be set per-agent or per-collection via `executorConfig.url`, which takes precedence over the environment variable.

---

## API Reference

### Health Check

```
GET /health
```

No authentication required.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "info": {
    "runtime": "deno",
    "denoVersion": "2.1.9",
    "activeSessions": 3,
    "maxSessions": 50,
    "cachedModules": 12,
    "capabilities": {
      "sessions": true,
      "executeToolWithSession": true
    }
  }
}
```

### Metrics

```
GET /metrics
```

No authentication required. Returns operational metrics for monitoring.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "uptime": 3600000,
  "sessions": {
    "active": 3,
    "max": 50,
    "totalCreated": 150,
    "totalDestroyed": 147
  },

  },

  },

  }

```

### Create/Resume Session

```
POST /sessions
Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
  "timeoutSeconds": 3600
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
  "workDir": "/tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions/agent123_conv456/workspace",
  "createdAt": "2026-02-16T10:00:00.000Z",
  "expiresAt": "2026-02-16T11:00:00.000Z",
  "resumed": false
}
```

Idempotent: if session exists, `resumed: true` and TTL is extended.

### Get Session

```
GET /sessions/{sessionId}
Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
  "workDir": "/tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions/agent123_conv456/workspace",
  "createdAt": "2026-02-16T10:00:00.000Z",
  "expiresAt": "2026-02-16T11:00:00.000Z",
  "toolCallCount": 7
}
```

Returns `404` if session is expired or doesn't exist.

### Destroy Session

```
DELETE /sessions/{sessionId}
Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
  "destroyed": true
}
```

Removes session and deletes workspace directory.

### Execute Tool

```
POST /execute-tool
Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
  "name": "shellExec",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "params": { "command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1" },
  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
  "env": { "GITHUB_TOKEN": "ghp_..." }
}
```

**Response (success):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "output": {
    "stdout": "Cloning into 'repo'...\n",
    "stderr": "",
    "exitCode": 0,
    "durationMs": 2341,
    "truncated": false
  },
  "executionTimeMs": 2500
}
```

**Response (error):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Session disk quota exceeded: 105MB / 100MB",
  "executionTimeMs": 12
}
```

| Field | Required | Description |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| `packageName` | Yes | npm package name (e.g. `@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell`) |
| `name` | Yes | Named export from the package |
| `version` | No | Package version (default: `latest`) |
| `params` | No | Parameters passed to `tool.execute()` |
| `sessionId` | No | Session ID for workspace resolution |
| `env` | No | Environment variables set for this execution only |
| `importUrl` | No | Override the esm.sh import URL |

**Execution flow:**
1. Load module from cache or `esm.sh`
2. Resolve session workspace from `sessionId`
3. Check disk quota
4. Set environment variables
5. Inject `_sandboxWorkDir` into params
6. Call `tool.execute(params)`
7. Clean up environment variables
8. Return result

---

## Security Model

### Authentication

All endpoints except `/health` and `/metrics` require a Bearer token when `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` is set. If unset, auth is disabled (development mode only).

### Path Sandboxing

All file tools enforce workspace boundaries:

1. **Path normalization**: `../` segments are resolved and checked
2. **Boundary check**: Resolved path must start with `workDir`
3. **Symlink detection**: `Deno.realPath()` verifies the canonical path stays in workspace
4. **Escape rejection**: Throws `"Path escapes sandbox workspace"` on violation

```typescript
function resolveSandboxPath(workDir: string, relativePath: string): string {
  // Normalize, resolve .., validate prefix
  if (!final.startsWith(normalizedWorkDir)) {
    throw new Error(`Path escapes sandbox workspace: ${relativePath}`);
  }
  return final;
}
```

### Disk Quotas

Before every tool execution, the server checks workspace size:

```
if (usageKB > SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB * 1024) → HTTP 413
```

Default: 100 MB per session.

### Process Isolation

- The Deno server runs as the `deno` user (non-root)
- Write access is restricted to `/tmp` (`--allow-write=/tmp`)
- Each session has its own workspace directory
- Environment variables are cleaned up after each tool call

### Timeout Protection

- `shellExec`: Configurable per-call (default 30s, max 5min)
- `SIGTERM` → 2s grace → `SIGKILL`
- HTTP-level timeout on executor calls: 5 minutes
- Session creation timeout: 15 seconds

### Output Truncation

| Resource | Limit |
|----------|-------|
| stdout/stderr | 100 KB each |
| File reads | 500 KB |
| Directory listings | 1000 entries |

### Git Credential Helper

Private repos can be cloned using a `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable. The credential helper (`git-credential-env`) is a system-level git config that reads the token from the environment:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "get" ]; then
  if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
    echo "protocol=https"
    echo "host=github.com"
    echo "username=x-access-token"
    echo "password=$GITHUB_TOKEN"
  fi
fi
```

---

## Deployment

### Railway (Recommended)

[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/template)

```bash
# Or deploy via CLI
cd templates/agent-sandbox
railway init
railway up
```

Set environment variables in Railway dashboard:
- `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` — your chosen secret
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` — (optional) for private repo cloning

### Docker

```bash
# Build
docker build -t tpmjs-sandbox templates/agent-sandbox/

# Run
docker run -p 3002:3002 \
  -e EXECUTOR_API_KEY=your-secret-key \
  -e GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_optional \
  tpmjs-sandbox
```

### Dockerfile Details

```dockerfile
FROM denoland/deno:2.1.9

# System packages: curl (health checks), git, openssh-client (private repos)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl git openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Session storage
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions && chown -R deno:deno /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox

# Git credential helper for GITHUB_TOKEN
COPY git-credential-env /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env && \
    git config --system credential.helper '/usr/local/bin/git-credential-env'

# Deno permissions: network, env, read, write to /tmp, subprocess execution
USER deno
CMD ["deno", "run", "--allow-net", "--allow-env", "--allow-read", \
     "--allow-write=/tmp", "--allow-run", "server.ts"]
```

### Connecting the Web App

Set `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` in `apps/web/.env.local`:

```env
AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=https://your-sandbox.up.railway.app
```

Or configure per-agent in the database:

```sql
UPDATE agents SET
  executor_type = 'sandbox',
  executor_config = '{"type":"sandbox","url":"https://your-sandbox.up.railway.app","apiKey":"your-secret"}'
WHERE id = 'agent-id';
```

---

## Local Development

### Run the Sandbox Server

```bash
cd templates/agent-sandbox

# Without auth (development)
deno run --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write=/tmp --allow-run server.ts

# With auth
EXECUTOR_API_KEY=dev-secret deno run --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write=/tmp --allow-run server.ts
```

### Run with Docker

```bash
docker build -t tpmjs-sandbox .
docker run -p 3002:3002 tpmjs-sandbox
```

### Point the Web App at Local Sandbox

```env
# apps/web/.env.local
AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=http://localhost:3002
```

### Quick Manual Test

```bash
# Health check
curl http://localhost:3002/health | jq .

# Create session
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/sessions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sessionId": "test:1"}'

# Run a command
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
    "name": "shellExec",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "params": {"command": "echo hello world"},
    "sessionId": "test:1"
  }'

# Clean up
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:3002/sessions/test:1
```

---

## Testing

### Integration Test Script

The `test-sandbox.sh` script exercises all 4 shell tools end-to-end:

```bash
# Against local instance (no auth)
./test-sandbox.sh

# Against deployed instance
./test-sandbox.sh https://sandbox.example.com your-api-key
```

**Test sequence:**
1. Health check
2. Create session
3. `shellExec`: write a file with echo
4. `readFile`: verify content
5. `writeFile`: create `src/index.js`
6. `listFiles`: verify workspace contents
7. `shellExec`: `git clone` (shallow)
8. `listFiles`: verify cloned repo
9. `shellExec`: `git log` in cloned repo
10. Destroy session

### E2E Integration Test

A full integration test at `apps/web/src/test/integration/sandbox/sandbox-shell-e2e.integration.test.ts` tests the complete flow through the web app:

1. Creates a test agent with sandbox executor
2. Multi-turn conversation: clone repo, create files, git commit
3. Verifies stateful persistence across turns
4. Tests conversation history retrieval with tool call metadata

```bash
INTEGRATION_TESTS=true AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=http://localhost:3002 pnpm test
```

### Blocks Validator

Validate tool definitions against the blocks.yml schema:

```bash
cd packages/tools/official
blocks run sandbox.shellExec
blocks run sandbox.readFile
blocks run sandbox.writeFile
blocks run sandbox.listFiles
```

### Build Verification

```bash
pnpm --filter=@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell type-check
pnpm --filter=@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell build
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### Session creation fails with "Sandbox executor URL not configured"

The web app can't find the sandbox server URL. Either:
- Set `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` in `apps/web/.env.local`
- Or set `executorConfig.url` on the agent in the database

### Disk quota exceeded (HTTP 413)

A session has used more than 100 MB. The agent needs to clean up files or start a new conversation. Adjust `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` if needed.

### Tool execution timeout

Default timeout is 30 seconds for `shellExec`. For long operations like `git clone` of large repos, the agent should pass `"timeout": 60000` or higher (max 300000).

### "Maximum concurrent sessions reached"

The server is at capacity. Sessions expire after 1 hour by default. Either:
- Wait for sessions to expire
- Increase `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS`
- Destroy idle sessions manually

### Module import failures

The sandbox server imports npm packages from `esm.sh`. If a package fails to load:
- Check the package is published to npm
- Check `esm.sh` status
- Try specifying `importUrl` to use a different CDN

### Git clone fails for private repos

Ensure `GITHUB_TOKEN` is set as an environment variable on the sandbox server (not just in the web app). The credential helper reads it from the server's environment.

### Files disappear between tool calls

Check that the same `sessionId` is being used. The conversation route generates `{agentId}:{conversationId}` — if the conversation ID changes, it's a new session.

### "Path escapes sandbox workspace"

A tool tried to read/write outside the workspace (e.g. `../../etc/passwd`). This is a security violation and is blocked. All paths must be relative to the workspace root.

# TPMJS Agent Sandbox

Stateful execution server for TPMJS agents. Files created by one tool call persist for subsequent calls within the same conversation.

## Deploy to Railway

[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/template)

```bash
# Or deploy via CLI
railway init
railway up
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` | No | - | Bearer token for authentication |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS` | No | `50` | Maximum concurrent sessions |
| `DEFAULT_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS` | No | `3600` | Session timeout (1 hour) |
| `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` | No | `100` | Per-session disk quota |
| `PORT` | No | `3002` | Server port |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | No | - | GitHub PAT for cloning private repos |

## API Endpoints

### Sessions

```bash
# Create/resume a session
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/sessions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"sessionId": "agent123:conv456"}'

# Get session status
curl http://localhost:3002/sessions/agent123:conv456 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY"

# Destroy a session
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:3002/sessions/agent123:conv456 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY"
```

### Tool Execution

```bash
# Execute a tool within a session
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/hello",
    "name": "helloWorldTool",
    "version": "0.0.2",
    "params": {"includeTimestamp": true},
    "sessionId": "agent123:conv456"
  }'
```

### Shell Tools (`@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell`)

The sandbox includes 4 shell tools for file I/O, directory listing, and command execution:

```bash
# shellExec — run any command in the workspace
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
    "name": "shellExec",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "params": {"command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1"},
    "sessionId": "agent123:conv456"
  }'

# readFile — read a file from the workspace
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
    "name": "readFile",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "params": {"path": "repo/README.md"},
    "sessionId": "agent123:conv456"
  }'

# writeFile — create or overwrite a file
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
    "name": "writeFile",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "params": {"path": "src/index.js", "content": "console.log(\"hello\");"},
    "sessionId": "agent123:conv456"
  }'

# listFiles — list directory contents
curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXECUTOR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
    "name": "listFiles",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "params": {"path": ".", "recursive": true, "maxDepth": 2},
    "sessionId": "agent123:conv456"
  }'
```

### Health Check

```bash
curl http://localhost:3002/health
```

## Local Development

```bash
deno run --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write=/tmp --allow-run server.ts
```

## Docker

```bash
docker build -t tpmjs-sandbox .
docker run -p 3002:3002 -e EXECUTOR_API_KEY=your-key tpmjs-sandbox
```

## Testing

Run the integration test against a running sandbox:

```bash
# Against local instance
./test-sandbox.sh

# Against deployed instance
./test-sandbox.sh https://sandbox.example.com your-api-key
```

The test script creates a session, exercises all 4 shell tools (including a git clone), and cleans up.

1→#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2→# ===========================================================================
     3→# test-sandbox.sh — Integration test for TPMJS Agent Sandbox shell tools
     4→#
     5→# Usage:  ./test-sandbox.sh [SANDBOX_URL] [API_KEY]
     6→#         Default URL: http://localhost:3002
     7→# ===========================================================================
     8→set -euo pipefail
     9→
    10→SANDBOX_URL="${1:-http://localhost:3002}"
    11→API_KEY="${2:-}"
    12→SESSION_ID="test-$$-$(date +%s)"
    13→
    14→AUTH_HEADER=""
    15→if [ -n "$API_KEY" ]; then
    16→  AUTH_HEADER="Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"
    17→fi
    18→
    19→PASS=0
    20→FAIL=0
    21→
    22→# Helper: make an authenticated request
    23→request() {
    24→  local method="$1" path="$2"
    25→  shift 2
    26→  if [ -n "$AUTH_HEADER" ]; then
    27→    curl -sf -X "$method" "${SANDBOX_URL}${path}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "$AUTH_HEADER" "$@"
    28→  else
    29→    curl -sf -X "$method" "${SANDBOX_URL}${path}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "$@"
    30→  fi
    31→}
    32→
    33→# Helper: execute a tool in the session
    34→exec_tool() {
    35→  local tool_name="$1" params="$2"
    36→  request POST /execute-tool -d "{
    37→    \"packageName\": \"@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell\",
    38→    \"name\": \"$tool_name\",
    39→    \"version\": \"0.1.0\",
    40→    \"params\": $params,
    41→    \"sessionId\": \"$SESSION_ID\"
    42→  }"
    43→}
    44→
    45→# Helper: check test result
    46→check() {
    47→  local label="$1" result="$2" expected="$3"
    48→  if echo "$result" | grep -q "$expected"; then
    49→    echo "  PASS: $label"
    50→    PASS=$((PASS + 1))
    51→  else
    52→    echo "  FAIL: $label (expected '$expected')"
    53→    echo "        Got: $result"
    54→    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
    55→  fi
    56→}
    57→
    58→echo "============================================"
    59→echo " TPMJS Agent Sandbox — Shell Tools Test"
    60→echo " URL: $SANDBOX_URL"
    61→echo " Session: $SESSION_ID"
    62→echo "============================================"
    63→echo
    64→
    65→# 1. Health check
    66→echo "1. Health check"
    67→HEALTH=$(request GET /health)
    68→check "Server healthy" "$HEALTH" '"status":"ok"'
    69→echo
    70→
    71→# 2. Create session
    72→echo "2. Create session"
    73→SESSION=$(request POST /sessions -d "{\"sessionId\": \"$SESSION_ID\"}")
    74→check "Session created" "$SESSION" '"success":true'
    75→echo
    76→
    77→# 3. shellExec — create a file with echo
    78→echo "3. shellExec: echo hello > test.txt"
    79→RESULT=$(exec_tool "shellExec" '{"command": "echo hello > test.txt && echo done"}')
    80→check "Exit code 0" "$RESULT" '"exitCode":0'
    81→check "Stdout has done" "$RESULT" 'done'
    82→echo
    83→
    84→# 4. readFile — verify content
    85→echo "4. readFile: test.txt"
    86→RESULT=$(exec_tool "readFile" '{"path": "test.txt"}')
    87→check "Content is hello" "$RESULT" 'hello'
    88→echo
    89→
    90→# 5. writeFile — create src/index.js
    91→echo "5. writeFile: src/index.js"
    92→RESULT=$(exec_tool "writeFile" '{"path": "src/index.js", "content": "console.log(\"hi\");\n"}')
    93→check "Write success" "$RESULT" '"success":true'
    94→echo
    95→
    96→# 6. listFiles — verify files exist
    97→echo "6. listFiles: workspace root"
    98→RESULT=$(exec_tool "listFiles" '{"recursive": true}')
    99→check "Has test.txt" "$RESULT" 'test.txt'
   100→check "Has src dir" "$RESULT" 'src'
   101→echo
   102→
   103→# 7. shellExec — git clone
   104→echo "7. shellExec: git clone (shallow)"
   105→RESULT=$(exec_tool "shellExec" '{"command": "git clone https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git --depth 1", "timeout": 60000}')
   106→check "Git clone succeeded" "$RESULT" '"exitCode":0'
   107→echo
   108→
   109→# 8. listFiles — cloned repo
   110→echo "8. listFiles: Hello-World/"
   111→RESULT=$(exec_tool "listFiles" '{"path": "Hello-World"}')
   112→check "Has README" "$RESULT" 'README'
   113→echo
   114→
   115→# 9. shellExec — git log in cloned repo
   116→echo "9. shellExec: git log in Hello-World"
   117→RESULT=$(exec_tool "shellExec" '{"command": "cd Hello-World && git log --oneline -3"}')
   118→check "Git log output" "$RESULT" '"exitCode":0'
   119→echo
   120→
   121→# 10. Destroy session
   122→echo "10. Destroy session"
   123→DESTROY=$(request DELETE "/sessions/$SESSION_ID")
   124→check "Session destroyed" "$DESTROY" '"success":true'
   125→echo
   126→
   127→# Summary
   128→echo "============================================"
   129→echo " Results: $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
   130→echo "============================================"
   131→
   132→if [ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ]; then
   133→  exit 1
   134→fi
   135→

1→# TPMJS Agent Sandbox Server
     2→FROM denoland/deno:2.1.9
     3→
     4→# Install curl for health checks
     5→USER root
     6→RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl git openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
     7→
     8→# Create sessions directory with correct permissions
     9→RUN mkdir -p /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions && chown -R deno:deno /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox
    10→
    11→# Set working directory
    12→WORKDIR /app
    13→
    14→# Set Deno cache directory
    15→ENV DENO_DIR=/tmp/deno-cache
    16→
    17→# Git credential helper (reads GITHUB_TOKEN from env for private repo clones)
    18→COPY git-credential-env /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env
    19→RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env && \
    20→    git config --system credential.helper '/usr/local/bin/git-credential-env'
    21→
    22→# Copy server file
    23→COPY server.ts .
    24→
    25→# Expose port (Railway will set PORT env var)
    26→EXPOSE 3002
    27→
    28→# Docker-level health check
    29→HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
    30→  CMD curl -f http://localhost:${PORT:-3002}/health || exit 1
    31→
    32→# Run as deno user with filesystem write permissions
    33→USER deno
    34→CMD ["deno", "run", "--allow-net", "--allow-env", "--allow-read", "--allow-write=/tmp", "--allow-run", "server.ts"]
    35→

1→# TPMJS Agent Sandbox
     2→
     3→Stateful execution server for TPMJS agents. Provides persistent filesystem sessions so files created by one tool call survive across subsequent calls within the same conversation. Built on Deno, deployed to Railway (or any Docker host).
     4→
     5→## Table of Contents
     6→
     7→- [Architecture Overview](#architecture-overview)
     8→- [How It Works](#how-it-works)
     9→- [Session Lifecycle](#session-lifecycle)
    10→- [Shell Tools](#shell-tools)
    11→- [Executor Configuration](#executor-configuration)
    12→- [Environment Variables](#environment-variables)
    13→- [API Reference](#api-reference)
    14→- [Security Model](#security-model)
    15→- [Deployment](#deployment)
    16→- [Local Development](#local-development)
    17→- [Testing](#testing)
    18→- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
    19→
    20→---
    21→
    22→## Architecture Overview
    23→
    24→```
    25→ User Message
    26→      |
    27→      v
    28→ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    29→ │  Next.js API Route (conversation/[id]/route.ts)  │
    30→ │                                                   │
    31→ │  1. Authenticate user                             │
    32→ │  2. Create/resume sandbox session                 │
    33→ │  3. Build tools from agent config                 │
    34→ │  4. Stream AI response via SSE                    │
    35→ │  5. Persist messages + tool results to DB         │
    36→ └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
    37→                         │
    38→           Tool call with sessionId
    39→                         │
    40→                         v
    41→ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    42→ │          Executor Layer (lib/executors)           │
    43→ │                                                   │
    44→ │  Resolves config cascade:                         │
    45→ │    Agent Config → Collection Config → Default     │
    46→ │                                                   │
    47→ │  Routes to correct executor:                      │
    48→ │    'default'    → package-executor (stateless)    │
    49→ │    'custom_url' → custom HTTP endpoint            │
    50→ │    'sandbox'    → Agent Sandbox Server ←──────    │
    51→ └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
    52→                         │
    53→               POST /execute-tool
    54→               { sessionId, params }
    55→                         │
    56→                         v
    57→ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    58→ │       Agent Sandbox Server (Deno, server.ts)     │
    59→ │                                                   │
    60→ │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
    61→ │  │ Session: agent123:conv456                    │ │
    62→ │  │ workDir: /tmp/.../workspace                  │ │
    63→ │  │ TTL: 1 hour (extends on each tool call)      │ │
    64→ │  │ Disk quota: 100 MB                           │ │
    65→ │  │                                              │ │
    66→ │  │  /workspace/                                 │ │
    67→ │  │  ├── cloned-repo/                            │ │
    68→ │  │  │   ├── .git/                               │ │
    69→ │  │  │   ├── src/                                │ │
    70→ │  │  │   └── README.md                           │ │
    71→ │  │  ├── output.txt                              │ │
    72→ │  │  └── notes.md                                │ │
    73→ │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
    74→ │                                                   │
    75→ │  Tool execution:                                  │
    76→ │  1. Load npm package from esm.sh                  │
    77→ │  2. Inject _sandboxWorkDir into params            │
    78→ │  3. Enforce disk quota                            │
    79→ │  4. Execute tool.execute(params)                  │
    80→ │  5. Return result                                 │
    81→ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    82→```
    83→
    84→### Components
    85→
    86→| Component | Location | Purpose |
    87→|-----------|----------|---------|
    88→| **Sandbox Server** | `templates/agent-sandbox/server.ts` | Deno HTTP server with session management, tool execution, module caching |
    89→| **Shell Tools** | `packages/tools/official/sandbox-shell/` | 4 tools: `shellExec`, `readFile`, `writeFile`, `listFiles` |
    90→| **Executor Layer** | `apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts` | Routes tool calls to sandbox with retry logic, session creation/destruction |
    91→| **Tool Builder** | `apps/web/src/lib/agents/build-tools.ts` | Builds AI SDK tool definitions with executor config cascade |
    92→| **Conversation Route** | `apps/web/src/app/api/[username]/agents/[agentSlug]/conversation/[conversationId]/route.ts` | SSE streaming endpoint, creates sessions, persists messages |
    93→| **Dockerfile** | `templates/agent-sandbox/Dockerfile` | Container with Deno, git, openssh-client, credential helper |
    94→
    95→---
    96→
    97→## How It Works
    98→
    99→### End-to-End Flow
   100→
   101→1. **User sends a message** to an agent configured with `executorType: 'sandbox'`
   102→2. **Conversation route** creates (or resumes) a sandbox session: `POST /sessions` with ID `{agentId}:{conversationId}`
   103→3. **AI model** decides to call a tool (e.g. `shellExec` with `git clone ...`)
   104→4. **Tool builder** wraps the tool in an executor-aware definition that routes the call to the sandbox server
   105→5. **Executor layer** sends `POST /execute-tool` to the sandbox with the `sessionId`
   106→6. **Sandbox server** resolves the session's `workDir`, injects `_sandboxWorkDir` into tool params, and executes
   107→7. **Tool runs** in the session workspace — files persist on disk
   108→8. **Result flows back** through the AI SDK to the model, which may call more tools or respond with text
   109→9. **Messages are persisted** to PostgreSQL (USER, ASSISTANT with toolCalls, TOOL with toolResult)
   110→10. **On conversation delete**, the session is destroyed (fire-and-forget)
   111→
   112→### Statefulness
   113→
   114→The key difference from the default executor is **persistence**. Within a sandbox session:
   115→
   116→- Files created by `writeFile` or `shellExec` persist across tool calls
   117→- Git repositories cloned in one turn are available in the next
   118→- The working directory is the same for every tool call in the session
   119→- Environment variables are injected per-call (not persistent across calls)
   120→
   121→### Module Loading
   122→
   123→The sandbox server dynamically imports npm packages from `esm.sh`:
   124→
   125→```
   126→https://esm.sh/@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell@0.1.0
   127→```
   128→
   129→Modules are cached in memory for 2 minutes (up to 200 entries). The server supports:
   130→- Direct tool exports (`export const toolName = tool({...})`)
   131→- Factory functions (`export function toolName(config) { return tool({...}) }`)
   132→- Zod schemas (converted via `zod-to-json-schema`)
   133→
   134→---
   135→
   136→## Session Lifecycle
   137→
   138→```
   139→ POST /sessions ─────────────────────► Session Created
   140→   { sessionId }                       workDir: /tmp/.../workspace
   141→                                       TTL: 1 hour
   142→                                       │
   143→                                       │ Each tool call:
   144→                                       │  - Extends TTL
   145→                                       │  - Increments toolCallCount
   146→                                       │  - Checks disk quota
   147→                                       │
   148→                                       ▼
   149→ POST /execute-tool ─────────────────► Tool Executes in workDir
   150→   { sessionId, packageName,           _sandboxWorkDir injected
   151→     name, params }                    │
   152→                                       │
   153→                 ┌─────────────────────┤
   154→                 │                     │
   155→                 ▼                     ▼
   156→         TTL Expires              DELETE /sessions/{id}
   157→         (cleanup timer)          (explicit destroy)
   158→                 │                     │
   159→                 ▼                     ▼
   160→         Session Destroyed ◄───────── workDir removed
   161→         (every 60s sweep)
   162→```
   163→
   164→### Session Properties
   165→
   166→| Property | Description |
   167→|----------|-------------|
   168→| `sessionId` | Unique ID, typically `{agentId}:{conversationId}` |
   169→| `workDir` | Filesystem path: `/tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions/{safe-id}/workspace` |
   170→| `createdAt` | When the session was first created |
   171→| `expiresAt` | TTL deadline, extended on every tool call |
   172→| `toolCallCount` | Number of tool calls executed in this session |
   173→
   174→### Idempotent Creation
   175→
   176→Calling `POST /sessions` with an existing `sessionId` doesn't create a new session — it extends the TTL and returns the existing one with `resumed: true`. This makes it safe to call at the start of every conversation turn.
   177→
   178→### Cleanup
   179→
   180→- **TTL expiration**: A sweep runs every 60 seconds, destroying sessions past their `expiresAt`
   181→- **Explicit deletion**: `DELETE /sessions/{id}` immediately destroys the session and removes files
   182→- **Orphan cleanup**: On server startup, any leftover session directories from a previous run are removed
   183→- **Graceful shutdown**: `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` destroy all active sessions before exit
   184→
   185→---
   186→
   187→## Shell Tools
   188→
   189→The `@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell` package provides 4 tools that run inside the sandbox workspace.
   190→
   191→### `shellExec`
   192→
   193→Execute any shell command in the workspace.
   194→
   195→```json
   196→{
   197→  "command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1",
   198→  "timeout": 60000
   199→}
   200→```
   201→
   202→**Returns:**
   203→```json
   204→{
   205→  "stdout": "Cloning into 'repo'...\n",
   206→  "stderr": "",
   207→  "exitCode": 0,
   208→  "durationMs": 2341,
   209→  "truncated": false
   210→}
   211→```
   212→
   213→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   214→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   215→| `command` | string | *required* | Shell command (passed to `sh -c`) |
   216→| `timeout` | number | 30000 | Timeout in ms (min: 1000, max: 300000) |
   217→
   218→**Behavior:**
   219→- Runs via `Deno.Command('sh', { args: ['-c', command], cwd: workDir })`
   220→- On timeout: sends `SIGTERM`, waits 2s, then `SIGKILL`
   221→- stdout/stderr truncated at 100 KB each
   222→- Exit code 137 indicates timeout kill
   223→
   224→### `readFile`
   225→
   226→Read a file from the workspace.
   227→
   228→```json
   229→{
   230→  "path": "repo/src/index.ts"
   231→}
   232→```
   233→
   234→**Returns:**
   235→```json
   236→{
   237→  "content": "console.log('hello');\n",
   238→  "path": "repo/src/index.ts",
   239→  "size": 22,
   240→  "truncated": false
   241→}
   242→```
   243→
   244→| Parameter | Type | Description |
   245→|-----------|------|-------------|
   246→| `path` | string | File path relative to workspace root |
   247→
   248→**Behavior:**
   249→- Content truncated at 500 KB
   250→- Symlink escape detection via `Deno.realPath()`
   251→- Path traversal (`../`) blocked
   252→
   253→### `writeFile`
   254→
   255→Create or overwrite a file.
   256→
   257→```json
   258→{
   259→  "path": "src/main.py",
   260→  "content": "print('hello')\n",
   261→  "createDirs": true
   262→}
   263→```
   264→
   265→**Returns:**
   266→```json
   267→{
   268→  "success": true,
   269→  "path": "src/main.py",
   270→  "bytesWritten": 16
   271→}
   272→```
   273→
   274→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   275→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   276→| `path` | string | *required* | File path relative to workspace root |
   277→| `content` | string | *required* | Content to write |
   278→| `createDirs` | boolean | true | Create parent directories if needed |
   279→
   280→### `listFiles`
   281→
   282→List files and directories.
   283→
   284→```json
   285→{
   286→  "path": "repo",
   287→  "recursive": true,
   288→  "maxDepth": 2
   289→}
   290→```
   291→
   292→**Returns:**
   293→```json
   294→{
   295→  "path": "repo",
   296→  "entries": [
   297→    { "name": "README.md", "type": "file", "size": 1024 },
   298→    { "name": "src", "type": "directory", "size": null },
   299→    { "name": "src/index.ts", "type": "file", "size": 256 }
   300→  ],
   301→  "truncated": false
   302→}
   303→```
   304→
   305→| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
   306→|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
   307→| `path` | string | `.` | Directory path relative to workspace root |
   308→| `recursive` | boolean | false | List recursively |
   309→| `maxDepth` | number | 3 | Max depth for recursive listing |
   310→
   311→**Behavior:**
   312→- Capped at 1000 entries (sets `truncated: true` beyond that)
   313→- Symlinks pointing outside workspace are silently skipped
   314→- Broken symlinks are skipped
   315→
   316→### `_sandboxWorkDir` Injection
   317→
   318→All tools accept a `_sandboxWorkDir` parameter, but agents never set it directly. The sandbox server injects it automatically:
   319→
   320→```typescript
   321→// server.ts line 420
   322→const executeParams = cwd ? { ...params, _sandboxWorkDir: cwd } : params;

   324→
   325→If `_sandboxWorkDir` is missing (tool called outside a sandbox), all tools throw a clear error.
   326→
   327→---
   328→
   329→## Executor Configuration
   330→
   331→### Cascade Resolution
   332→
   333→Tool execution is routed through a 3-level cascade:
   334→
   335→```
   336→Agent.executorType / Agent.executorConfig     (highest priority)
   337→  └── Collection.executorType / Collection.executorConfig
   338→        └── System default                    (lowest priority)
   339→```
   340→
   341→This means:
   342→- An agent-level executor config applies to **all** tools in the agent
   343→- A collection-level executor config applies only to tools from that collection
   344→- The system default (`package-executor`) is used when nothing else is configured
   345→
   346→### Executor Types
   347→
   348→| Type | Description | Config Fields |
   349→|------|-------------|---------------|
   350→| `default` | TPMJS default stateless executor | None |
   351→| `custom_url` | Your own HTTP executor endpoint | `url`, `apiKey` |
   352→| `sandbox` | Agent Sandbox with persistent sessions | `url` (optional), `apiKey` (optional) |
   353→
   354→### Database Schema
   355→
   356→```prisma
   357→model Agent {
   358→  executorType    String?   // 'default', 'custom_url', 'sandbox'
   359→  executorConfig  Json?     // { type, url?, apiKey? }
   360→  envVars         Json?     // { KEY: "value", ... }
   361→}
   362→
   363→model Collection {
   364→  executorType    String?
   365→  executorConfig  Json?
   366→  envVars         Json?
   367→}
   368→```
   369→
   370→### Environment Variable Merging
   371→
   372→Environment variables are merged with agent-level overriding collection-level:
   373→
   374→```
   375→Collection envVars:  { API_KEY: "coll-key", REGION: "us-east-1" }
   376→Agent envVars:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", DEBUG: "true" }
   377→                          ↓
   378→Merged result:       { API_KEY: "agent-key", REGION: "us-east-1", DEBUG: "true" }
   379→```
   380→
   381→Env vars are passed to the sandbox server per tool call and cleaned up after execution.
   382→
   383→---
   384→
   385→## Environment Variables
   386→
   387→### Sandbox Server
   388→
   389→| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
   390→|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
   391→| `PORT` | No | `3002` | Server port |
   392→| `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` | No | — | Bearer token for authentication. If unset, auth is disabled. |
   393→| `MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS` | No | `50` | Maximum concurrent sessions |
   394→| `DEFAULT_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS` | No | `3600` | Session timeout (1 hour) |
   395→| `SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB` | No | `100` | Per-session disk quota |
   396→| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | No | — | GitHub PAT for cloning private repos via credential helper |
   397→
   398→### Web App
   399→
   400→| Variable | Required | Description |
   401→|----------|----------|-------------|
   402→| `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` | Yes (for sandbox agents) | URL of the sandbox server (e.g. `https://sandbox.example.com`) |
   403→
   404→The URL can also be set per-agent or per-collection via `executorConfig.url`, which takes precedence over the environment variable.
   405→
   406→---

   408→## API Reference
   409→

   411→
   412→```
   413→GET /health
   414→```

   416→No authentication required.

   418→**Response:**

   422→  "version": "1.0.0",
   423→  "info": {
   424→    "runtime": "deno",
   425→    "denoVersion": "2.1.9",
   426→    "activeSessions": 3,
   427→    "maxSessions": 50,
   428→    "cachedModules": 12,
   429→    "capabilities": {
   430→      "sessions": true,
   431→      "executeToolWithSession": true
   432→    }
   433→  }
   434→}
   435→```
   436→
   437→### Metrics
   438→
   439→```
   440→GET /metrics
   441→```
   442→
   443→No authentication required. Returns operational metrics for monitoring.
   444→
   445→**Response:**
   446→```json
   447→{
   448→  "uptime": 3600000,
   449→  "sessions": {
   450→    "active": 3,
   451→    "max": 50,
   452→    "totalCreated": 150,
   453→    "totalDestroyed": 147
   454→  },
   455→  "executions": {

   471→
   472→### Create/Resume Session
   473→
   474→```
   475→POST /sessions
   476→Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
   477→Content-Type: application/json
   478→
   479→{
   480→  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",

   490→  "createdAt": "2026-02-16T10:00:00.000Z",
   491→  "expiresAt": "2026-02-16T11:00:00.000Z",

   495→
   496→Idempotent: if session exists, `resumed: true` and TTL is extended.
   497→
   498→### Get Session
   499→

   501→GET /sessions/{sessionId}

   506→```json

   508→  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",

   510→  "createdAt": "2026-02-16T10:00:00.000Z",

   518→### Destroy Session
   519→
   520→```
   521→DELETE /sessions/{sessionId}

   532→
   533→Removes session and deletes workspace directory.
   534→
   535→### Execute Tool
   536→
   537→```
   538→POST /execute-tool
   539→Authorization: Bearer <EXECUTOR_API_KEY>
   540→Content-Type: application/json
   541→
   542→{
   543→  "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
   544→  "name": "shellExec",
   545→  "version": "0.1.0",
   546→  "params": { "command": "git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git --depth 1" },
   547→  "sessionId": "agent123:conv456",
   548→  "env": { "GITHUB_TOKEN": "ghp_..." }
   549→}
   550→```
   551→
   552→**Response (success):**
   553→```json
   554→{
   555→  "success": true,
   556→  "output": {
   557→    "stdout": "Cloning into 'repo'...\n",
   558→    "stderr": "",
   559→    "exitCode": 0,
   560→    "durationMs": 2341,
   561→    "truncated": false
   562→  },
   563→  "executionTimeMs": 2500
   564→}
   565→```
   566→
   567→**Response (error):**
   568→```json
   569→{
   570→  "success": false,
   571→  "error": "Session disk quota exceeded: 105MB / 100MB",
   572→  "executionTimeMs": 12
   573→}
   574→```
   575→
   576→| Field | Required | Description |
   577→|-------|----------|-------------|
   578→| `packageName` | Yes | npm package name (e.g. `@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell`) |
   579→| `name` | Yes | Named export from the package |
   580→| `version` | No | Package version (default: `latest`) |
   581→| `params` | No | Parameters passed to `tool.execute()` |
   582→| `sessionId` | No | Session ID for workspace resolution |
   583→| `env` | No | Environment variables set for this execution only |
   584→| `importUrl` | No | Override the esm.sh import URL |
   585→
   586→**Execution flow:**
   587→1. Load module from cache or `esm.sh`
   588→2. Resolve session workspace from `sessionId`
   589→3. Check disk quota
   590→4. Set environment variables
   591→5. Inject `_sandboxWorkDir` into params
   592→6. Call `tool.execute(params)`
   593→7. Clean up environment variables
   594→8. Return result
   595→
   596→---
   597→
   598→## Security Model
   599→
   600→### Authentication
   601→
   602→All endpoints except `/health` and `/metrics` require a Bearer token when `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` is set. If unset, auth is disabled (development mode only).
   603→
   604→### Path Sandboxing
   605→
   606→All file tools enforce workspace boundaries:
   607→
   608→1. **Path normalization**: `../` segments are resolved and checked
   609→2. **Boundary check**: Resolved path must start with `workDir`
   610→3. **Symlink detection**: `Deno.realPath()` verifies the canonical path stays in workspace
   611→4. **Escape rejection**: Throws `"Path escapes sandbox workspace"` on violation
   612→
   613→```typescript
   614→function resolveSandboxPath(workDir: string, relativePath: string): string {
   615→  // Normalize, resolve .., validate prefix
   616→  if (!final.startsWith(normalizedWorkDir)) {
   617→    throw new Error(`Path escapes sandbox workspace: ${relativePath}`);
   618→  }
   619→  return final;
   620→}
   621→```
   622→
   623→### Disk Quotas
   624→
   625→Before every tool execution, the server checks workspace size:
   626→
   627→```
   628→if (usageKB > SESSION_DISK_QUOTA_MB * 1024) → HTTP 413
   629→```
   630→
   631→Default: 100 MB per session.
   632→
   633→### Process Isolation
   634→
   635→- The Deno server runs as the `deno` user (non-root)
   636→- Write access is restricted to `/tmp` (`--allow-write=/tmp`)
   637→- Each session has its own workspace directory
   638→- Environment variables are cleaned up after each tool call
   639→
   640→### Timeout Protection
   641→
   642→- `shellExec`: Configurable per-call (default 30s, max 5min)
   643→- `SIGTERM` → 2s grace → `SIGKILL`
   644→- HTTP-level timeout on executor calls: 5 minutes
   645→- Session creation timeout: 15 seconds
   646→
   647→### Output Truncation
   648→
   649→| Resource | Limit |
   650→|----------|-------|
   651→| stdout/stderr | 100 KB each |
   652→| File reads | 500 KB |
   653→| Directory listings | 1000 entries |
   654→
   655→### Git Credential Helper
   656→
   657→Private repos can be cloned using a `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable. The credential helper (`git-credential-env`) is a system-level git config that reads the token from the environment:
   658→
   659→```sh
   660→#!/bin/sh
   661→if [ "$1" = "get" ]; then
   662→  if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
   663→    echo "protocol=https"
   664→    echo "host=github.com"
   665→    echo "username=x-access-token"
   666→    echo "password=$GITHUB_TOKEN"
   667→  fi
   668→fi
   669→```
   670→
   671→---
   672→
   673→## Deployment
   674→
   675→### Railway (Recommended)
   676→
   677→[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/template)
   678→
   679→```bash
   680→# Or deploy via CLI
   681→cd templates/agent-sandbox
   682→railway init
   683→railway up
   684→```
   685→
   686→Set environment variables in Railway dashboard:
   687→- `EXECUTOR_API_KEY` — your chosen secret
   688→- `GITHUB_TOKEN` — (optional) for private repo cloning
   689→
   690→### Docker
   691→
   692→```bash
   693→# Build
   694→docker build -t tpmjs-sandbox templates/agent-sandbox/
   695→
   696→# Run
   697→docker run -p 3002:3002 \
   698→  -e EXECUTOR_API_KEY=your-secret-key \
   699→  -e GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_optional \
   700→  tpmjs-sandbox
   701→```
   702→
   703→### Dockerfile Details
   704→
   705→```dockerfile
   706→FROM denoland/deno:2.1.9
   707→
   708→# System packages: curl (health checks), git, openssh-client (private repos)
   709→RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
   710→    curl git openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
   711→
   712→# Session storage
   713→RUN mkdir -p /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox/sessions && chown -R deno:deno /tmp/tpmjs-sandbox
   714→
   715→# Git credential helper for GITHUB_TOKEN
   716→COPY git-credential-env /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env
   717→RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/git-credential-env && \
   718→    git config --system credential.helper '/usr/local/bin/git-credential-env'
   719→
   720→# Deno permissions: network, env, read, write to /tmp, subprocess execution
   721→USER deno
   722→CMD ["deno", "run", "--allow-net", "--allow-env", "--allow-read", \
   723→     "--allow-write=/tmp", "--allow-run", "server.ts"]
   724→```
   725→
   726→### Connecting the Web App
   727→
   728→Set `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL` in `apps/web/.env.local`:
   729→

   731→AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=https://your-sandbox.up.railway.app
   732→```
   733→
   734→Or configure per-agent in the database:
   735→

   738→  executor_type = 'sandbox',
   739→  executor_config = '{"type":"sandbox","url":"https://your-sandbox.up.railway.app","apiKey":"your-secret"}'
   740→WHERE id = 'agent-id';
   741→```

   770→AGENT_SANDBOX_URL=http://localhost:3002
   771→```
   772→
   773→### Quick Manual Test
   774→
   775→```bash
   776→# Health check
   777→curl http://localhost:3002/health | jq .
   778→
   779→# Create session
   780→curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/sessions \
   781→  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   782→  -d '{"sessionId": "test:1"}'
   783→
   784→# Run a command
   785→curl -X POST http://localhost:3002/execute-tool \
   786→  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   787→  -d '{
   788→    "packageName": "@tpmjs/official-sandbox-shell",
   789→    "name": "shellExec",
   790→    "version": "0.1.0",
   791→    "params": {"command": "echo hello world"},

   793→  }'
   794→
   795→# Clean up
